text:
Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists Equipment Inspection Checklist I1, which
must be performed 
every 3 years (Y3) as indicated in the title block. This document 
was initiated at Abu-Zaabal 500kv substation, Cairo.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified
maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Turn off the power source.
Lock the mechanism by mechanical lock pin.
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the
work area.
Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety
glasses.
Don't burn the cloth used in cleaning, collect it and
send it to the dump.
Tools and
Equipment
Safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glasses.
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks.
Air Blower,
500v
 megger
Work to be Carried Out
Check presence of rust outside the mechanism box.
Check presence of dew condensation and rust within
 mechanism box.
Check movement of mechanism.
Check condition of position indicator.
Check Lever stopper gap:
 Open position 0.5 -- 8 mm
 Closed position 0.5 -- 13 mm
 Figure 1 Lever Stopper Gap
Check the wiring terminal condition.
Check the tightening parts condition.
Check the insulation resistance between control
 circuit and ground (more than 2M ohm with 500V megger).
